title: Primary Create a room CTA routes to memory mode instead of a live production room
timestampInVideo: followup-landing-create-cta video, after clicking Create a room
reproSteps: Click the primary Create a room CTA
Observe the resulting URL and mode
expected: The primary production CTA should create or open a live production room, or clearly label itself as a local/demo memory-room flow.
actual: The CTA href is /?mode=memory&surface=desktop and the browser lands at https://noderoom.live/?mode=memory&surface=desktop.
suspectedCause: Marketing CTA still points to deterministic memory/demo route instead of the live room creation/join route.
userImpact: A first-time production user cannot start the real live-room workflow from the strongest CTA and may believe they are using production while actually in memory mode.
suggestedFix: Change the production CTA to create a live room or split the CTAs into clearly labeled Live room and Try local demo actions.

title: Export XLSX affordance does not produce a browser download
timestampInVideo: export-xlsx video, click on Export XLSX
expected: Clicking Export XLSX should emit a downloadable .xlsx file or show an explicit error state.
actual: Playwright waited 30 seconds for a download event after clicking Export XLSX and timed out. The UI remained in the room with no visible error.
suspectedCause: Export handler is not wired on the live sheet surface, is blocked by state, or does not call the browser download API.
userImpact: Users cannot take spreadsheet work out of NodeRoom, which blocks handoff and offline review.
suggestedFix: Wire Export XLSX to a deterministic download path and add a visible failure toast if export cannot be generated.

title: First-run onboarding modal blocks the live room until dismissed
persona: First-time visitor, invited collaborator/guest, mobile user
timestampInVideo: desktop-room and mobile-room videos, first room render
reproSteps: Join a fresh room in a new browser context
Observe the first visible room state
Try to interact with the room before dismissing the overlay
expected: Onboarding should not hide the full product state or block core chat/collaboration actions without making the dismissal path obvious.
actual: A full-screen/modal onboarding step appears over the room in each fresh context. Desktop room contents are blurred behind it; mobile shows a blocking Got it card before the room is usable.
suspectedCause: Tour gating is implemented as a blocking modal and is scoped per fresh context rather than being progressive or non-blocking.
userImpact: A collaborator landing in a room has to dismiss product education before doing the work they came for; automation also mistakes the room as unavailable until the overlay is handled.
suggestedFix: Make onboarding non-blocking after join, preserve a visible Skip/Got it control, and add a test that chat is usable immediately after dismissing it.

title: Production pages emit CSP errors for blocked inline script and event handlers
timestampInVideo: console logs across root and room loads
reproSteps: Open or join a live room
expected: Production pages should not emit console errors under the deployed Content Security Policy.
actual: Console logs repeatedly report blocked inline script and inline event handlers under script-src 'self' at lines 22, 23, and 45.
suspectedCause: Deployed HTML still includes inline script/event-handler snippets that are incompatible with the production CSP.
userImpact: The current tested flows still worked, but blocked inline handlers are fragile production debt and can break fallback behavior or analytics under stricter browsers.
suggestedFix: Move inline script/event handlers into bundled JS or add a nonce/hash-based CSP strategy deliberately.

title: Landing page first contentful paint is slow in the QA run
reproSteps: Read browser navigation and paint timing
expected: The landing page should render first contentful paint comfortably under common production thresholds.
actual: The QA run recorded first paint and first contentful paint at about 3600 ms. Console logs also reported unused preloaded font resources.
suspectedCause: Font preloads and render-critical assets may not be tuned for the deployed landing page.
userImpact: A cold first-time visitor can wait long enough for the page to feel less polished.
suggestedFix: Audit font loading/preload hints and add a lightweight landing performance budget test.
